en.title: Israeli attacks in Gaza kill four Palestinians, including a child
en.dek: Reports from Gaza say Israeli attacks killed four or five people, including a child, on 5 November 2026, with outlets citing different tolls.
facts: The New Arab and Middle East Eye reported five deaths in Gaza, including a child.
Haaretz and Muslim Network TV reported four Palestinians killed.
Al Arabiya cited Gaza's civil defense in reporting four deaths, including a child.
Al Jazeera and Anadolu Agency reported four Palestinians killed in attacks across Gaza.
Democracy Now described the toll as at least four.
All reports were published on 5 November 2026.
body: Outlets reported different death tolls from Israeli attacks in Gaza on 5 November 2026, and the accounts split between four and five deaths. The New Arab and Middle East Eye said five people were killed, including a child. Haaretz and Muslim Network TV reported four Palestinians killed.
The New Arab and Middle East Eye published their reports on 5 November 2026, and both said the attacks killed five people, including a child.
Haaretz and Muslim Network TV also published their reports on 5 November 2026, and both reported that four Palestinians were killed.
Al Arabiya cited Gaza's civil defense in reporting that Israeli fire killed four people, including a child. Al Jazeera and Anadolu Agency reported four Palestinians killed in attacks across Gaza.
Democracy Now described the toll as at least four, and its report was published on 5 November 2026.
Coverage published during the evening of 5 November 2026 showed a difference between four and five deaths, and the reports described attacks across Gaza on the same day.
Eight news outlets reported on the attacks, and their accounts differ on the exact number of deaths.
en.context: All reports were published on 5 November 2026. Al Arabiya cited Gaza's civil defense for its casualty figure. The attacks took place across Gaza, according to Al Jazeera and Anadolu Agency.
